## About
Stinson Automotive is owned and operated by David Hansen and his wife LeAnn. David grew up in the northeast area and has known many of his customers for years.
David is an active member of AASP-MN, the Alliance for Automotive Service Professionals. He believes it's important for the shop to be active in its community and supportive of the local schools and parks.
We're rated 4.9 from 137 Google reviews. One reviewer called us an "honest and no-frills shop," and another said, "to other shops out there, this is how you do it."

## Services
- Troubleshooting: We track down what's actually wrong before replacing anything.
- Turbo, battery and AC work: One customer brought in a car needing a turbo replacement, a battery check and an AC fix, and got it back running.
- Suspension service: For bigger jobs we walk you through the estimate, and one reviewer said we offered a plan to split the work into safe steps over time.

## FAQ
Q: How do I get my car in?
A: Give us a call and we'll set up an appointment.

Q: Are you open on Saturday?
A: No, the shop is closed on Saturday.

Q: Where are you located?
A: We're at 3300 Stinson Blvd in Northeast Minneapolis.
